proposal.title: Convert Microsoft BASIC for Aurelia CP/M to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: Microsoft BASIC for Aurelia CP/M
before.description: Microsoft BASIC supplied as independently licensed third-party software for Aurelia and Aurelia+ CP/M. Developed in cooperation with AION, it uses the shared Logix TUI interface and capability discovery. This does not imply that the BASIC implementation is portable C or that Logix manufactures a distinct BASIC cartridge offering; its delivery medium remains unspecified.

specification.description: Microsoft supplies the independently licensed BASIC implementation.
Defines supported hosts, CP/M dependency, TUI integration and external-supplier delivery.
